# jupiterone_control_frameworks (Data Source)

The CCM frameworks in the account, together with their requirements. This is how to reference a framework the provider does not manage, such as one imported from the J1 or UCF catalog: read its requirement IDs here and attach managed controls to them.

These results are read from the graph, which is eventually consistent. An object created earlier in the same apply may not appear yet; a later plan or apply will show it. Do not rely on this data source to observe a change made moments earlier in the same run.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Frameworks together with their requirements.
#
# This is how to attach Terraform-managed controls to a framework the provider
# does not manage, such as one imported from the J1 or UCF catalog: read the
# requirement IDs here rather than hard-coding them.
data "jupiterone_control_frameworks" "all" {}

locals {
  soc2 = one([
    for f in data.jupiterone_control_frameworks.all.control_frameworks : f
    if f.name == "SOC 2"
  ])

  # Requirement IDs keyed by their identifier, e.g. "CC6.1".
  soc2_requirements = {
    for r in local.soc2.requirements : r.identifier => r.id if r.identifier != null
  }
}

resource "jupiterone_control" "mfa_for_soc2" {
  name            = "MFA enforced on all human identities"
  owner           = "security-team@example.com"
  state           = "LIVE"
  requirement_ids = [local.soc2_requirements["CC6.1"]]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_deleted` (Boolean) Also return frameworks that have been deleted. Deletion in CCM is a soft delete.

### Read-Only

- `control_frameworks` (Attributes List) The frameworks in the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--control_frameworks))
- `id` (String) A generated identifier for this result set.

<a id="nestedatt--control_frameworks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `control_frameworks`

Read-Only:

- `created_on` (String) When the framework was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the framework.
- `id` (String) The ID of the framework.
- `name` (String) The name of the framework.
- `owner` (String) The owner of the framework, represented by a user email.
- `requirements` (Attributes List) The requirements belonging to the framework. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--control_frameworks--requirements))
- `resource_group_id` (String) The resource group the framework is scoped to.
- `source` (String) Where the framework came from: J1, UCF, UPLOAD or JSON.
- `source_id` (String) The identifier of the framework in its source.

<a id="nestedatt--control_frameworks--requirements"></a>
### Nested Schema for `control_frameworks.requirements`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the requirement.
- `id` (String) The ID of the requirement. Use this to attach controls to the requirement.
- `identifier` (String) The identifier of the requirement.
- `priority` (String) The priority of the requirement: CRITICAL, HIGH, MEDIUM or LOW.
- `section` (String) The section of the framework this requirement belongs to.
- `title` (String) The title of the requirement.
